name: calcium activated nucleotidase 1

function.text: CANT1 is the approved symbol for calcium activated nucleotidase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ADP phosphatase activity; calcium ion binding; positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Desbuquois dysplasia 1 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CANT1 encodes calcium activated nucleotidase 1. It is a calcium-dependent nucleotidase with a preference for ribonucleosides diphosphate UDP, GDP and IDP, while having very low activity towards ADP and CDP. It does not hydrolyze AMP and GMP.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include Desbuquois dysplasia 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CANT1 have been reported in low-grade glioma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
